jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager, Operations and Claims
jobs.description:
Job Posting End Date: November 30

Who are we?

We’re a specialist employee benefits provider, striving to create healthy, happy workplaces. As part of the international Unum Group, we’re on a collective mission to help the working world thrive.

The role
What will you be doing?
○ Act as the key Finance Business Partner to the COO and senior Operations leadership team, providing strategic insight, robust challenge and commercial support to drive business performance and informed decision making.

○ Lead the financial planning, forecasting and analysis of claims performance across Unum's product portfolio, translating complex data into meaningful insights that influence operational and financial outcomes.

○ Develop and maintain cost and resource models that improve financial transparency, support planning decisions and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency across Operations.

○ Partner with stakeholders across Finance, Actuarial and Operations to evaluate investment and transformation initiatives, building compelling business cases and measuring the impact of change.

○ Act as the central point of coordination for claims forecasting, working closely with actuarial experts to ensure key assumptions and financial inputs are robust and aligned.

○ Oversee the production and continuous enhancement of claims management information, identifying trends, risks and opportunities that support better business decisions.

○ Drive improvements in forecasting methodologies, reporting capabilities and analytics, helping the business leverage data and technology more effectively.

○ Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team, creating an environment focused on accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and career development.

○ Build strong relationships across the wider business, influencing senior stakeholders and helping shape strategic priorities through trusted financial partnership.

○ Play an active role in embedding strong governance, risk management and regulatory compliance, including Consumer Duty, Treating Customers Fairly, Conduct Risk and Solvency II requirements.

What will you bring?

○ Qualified Accountant or Actuary with significant post-qualified experience within a complex financial environment.

○ Strong Finance Business Partnering experience with the ability to influence senior leaders and challenge constructively.

○ Deep understanding of FP&A, forecasting and business performance management within a large or complex organisation.

○ Experience developing financial models, claims forecasts, resource plans and business cases to support strategic decision making.

○ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable business insights.

○ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience building credibility across Finance and operational leadership teams.

○ A proven track record of leading, developing and coaching high-performing teams through periods of change and transformation.

○ Strong commercial awareness and the ability to balance operational objectives with financial performance and control.

○ Interest in finance systems, technology and continuous improvement, with a mindset focused on driving efficiency and innovation.

○ Experience within financial services, insurance, group risk or group income protection would be advantageous.

Location

Hybrid working. 3 days in office, 2 days from home. From office locations in Dorking, London or Basingstoke.

Benefits

○ Competitive salary and annual bonus
○ Generous pension scheme
○ Income Protection, Life Assurance and Critical Illness cover
○ Private Medical Insurance
○ Employee wellbeing and mental health support
○ Generous holiday allowance with the option to buy and sell leave
○ Electric vehicle scheme and other flexible lifestyle benefits
○ Career development opportunities and professional qualification support

Why join us?

At Unum, we’ve created a workplace where people feel supported to progress and grow, and can see their ambitions coming to life.

As a part of our commitment to creating an inclusive workplace , we actively encourage applications from those with disabilities and those with long-term health conditions.
If you meet the essential criteria for the role and choose to opt in to the scheme during your application, you will be offered an interview under the Disability Confident Scheme.

General Summary:
The Dir, Compensation Programs is responsible for the design, development, and management of our global compensation structure to include base, incentive, and recognition elements. This position will lead the transformation of our global compensation framework to enable career growth for employees, workforce management efficiency and our strategic business initiatives. They will use advanced analytics and predictive modeling to create compelling strategic insights that fuel the work. This role will require a candidate that has deep subject matter expertise, a strong ability to partner and build relationships, strong analytical capabilities, and creativity to drive successful and effective programs.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities
- Develop, design, and administer compensation programs that are internally equitable, market competitive, and compliant while supporting overall business objectives.
- Manage the global career framework, aligning and supporting career enablement for employees and workforce planning for leaders.
- Complete complex analytics and predictive modeling to formulate clear and insightful strategic compensation program recommendations that are market aligned and position Unum as an employer of choice.
- Partner closely with HR Business Partners and Senior Leadership Team to develop compensation initiatives that align, drive, and amplify Unum group’s strategic business and workforce goals.
- Design and oversee our annual compensation review process, including our annual incentive programs.
- Lead, coach, and develop a collaborative compensation team using a consultative approach
- Partner with our People Delivery Group to automate processes, dashboards and digitally enabled compensation processes that help drive decision making for leaders
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, external consultants, and vendors to improve programs, ensure competitiveness and optimize our portfolio.
- Partner with internal teams to develop and manage meaningful dashboards that help leaders manage and execute on their workforce management strategies.
- Maintain current knowledge of external compensation practices and trends including applicable legal regulations

Job Specifications
- Bachelor’s degree preferred
- Minimum of 7-10 years’ experience in the development and management of global compensation programs preferred
- Certified Compensation Consultant (CCP) designation is desired
- Demonstrated ability to translate global business strategies directly into actionable compensation work
- Demonstrated ability to assess business issues and develop effective solutions
- Ability to create strong partnerships and work effectively at all levels
- Strong influencing skills; Strong written and oral communication skills
- Flexibility to work well under pressure while managing multiple priorities and tight deadlines
- Strong math and statistical ability

Proficient with technology including HRIS, excel, PowerPoint and external vendor compensation solutions

jobs.description:

Who are we?

We’re a specialist employee benefits provider, striving to create healthy, happy workplaces. As part of the international Unum Group, we’re on a collective mission to help the working world thrive.

The role
What will you be doing?
.
.

The UK Category Manager / TPRM Lead develops and executes category, sourcing, supplier and/or third-party risk strategies that deliver sustainable commercial value, operational resilience, regulatory compliance and strong supplier performance.
Acting as a trusted adviser, the role manages strategic and critical suppliers across the supplier lifecycle and works with business, Legal, Risk and Compliance stakeholders to ensure supplier arrangements support Unum’s objectives and regulatory obligations. As part of a global organisation, the UK Category Manager looks to collaborate/leverage/adapt global category strategies and supplier relationships in order to drive best outcomes for the UK arm of the business.

This role provides the opportunity to bring your strengths and expand breadth of skills and experience across Sourcing, procurement excellence, sustainability and third-party risk management to shape strategic supplier relationships across critical business and technology services while driving commercial value, supplier performance, operational resilience and regulatory compliance. The successful candidate will be a natural collaborator and play a key role in supporting Unum's business objectives and strategy.

Category Strategy and Commercial Management

○ Develop and execute category strategies and strategic roadmaps aligned with business priorities, market conditions and future requirements.

○ Use market intelligence, benchmarking and commercial analysis to identify opportunities, shape decisions and optimise total value.

○ Lead end-to-end sourcing activity, including requirements challenge, supplier evaluation, RFI/RFP processes, negotiation, contracting and supplier selection.

Business Partnership

○ Build trusted relationships with business leaders and stakeholders, developing a strong understanding of their objectives, risks and priorities.

○ Provide clear commercial and supplier advice, influence decision-making and constructively challenge requirements to achieve effective, sustainable and risk-based outcomes.

Supplier Management and Governance

○ Manage strategic and critical supplier relationships across the supplier lifecycle, ensuring continued alignment with contractual commitments, service expectations and business needs.

○ Establish and lead proportionate supplier governance, performance reviews and improvement plans to strengthen accountability, service quality, innovation and continuous improvement.

Third-Party Risk, Resilience and Compliance

○ Ensure sourcing and supplier management activities comply with internal governance and applicable regulatory requirements, including FCA and PRA outsourcing expectations where relevant.

○ Lead or coordinate supplier due diligence and risk assessments, incorporating operational, financial, contractual, concentration, information security and resilience considerations into decisions.

○ Support the governance of material outsourcing and critical supplier arrangements, including ongoing assurance, transition and exit planning, whilst aligning with Operational teams on business continuity, operational resilience.

○ Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance and other control functions to maintain effective third-party oversight and timely resolution of risks and issues.
Performance and Improvement

○ Measure and report category, supplier, risk and commercial outcomes against agreed objectives, using insight to drive corrective action and continuous improvement.

○ Lead Procurement excellence and wider business initiatives to streamline processes, enhance ways of working, and the value Sourcing can bring to the business.

○ Contribute to Strategic Sourcing priorities and undertake other responsibilities appropriate to the role.

What will you bring?
.
.

Experience and Qualifications

○ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, relevant professional qualification or equivalent practical experience.

○ Typically 5–8 years’ relevant experience across either procurement, category management, supplier relationship management and/or third-party risk management.

○ Experience developing and delivering category, sourcing or supplier strategies in a complex organisation.

○ Experience managing strategic or critical suppliers in a regulated environment is desirable.

○ Experience in technology, professional services, marketing, business services or other indirect categories is desirable.

Commercial, Supplier and Risk Expertise

○ Proven experience leading complex commercial, contractual and risk negotiations and gaining alignment with business stakeholders, Sourcing, Legal, Risk and Compliance stakeholders.

○ Strong knowledge of third-party risk management, including due diligence, ongoing monitoring, supplier assurance, operational resilience, material outsourcing governance and exit planning.

○ Ability to balance commercial value, service quality, supplier performance, regulatory compliance and third-party risk when developing and executing strategies.

○ Experience establishing or operating supplier governance, performance management and executive review forums.

Capabilities and Behaviours

○ Excellent communication, relationship management and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage, challenge and advise senior stakeholders and suppliers.

○ Strong strategic, analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with a track record of delivering measurable outcomes.

○ Ability to manage a varied portfolio of sourcing, supplier and risk initiatives in a complex matrix environment.

○ Ability to communicate complex commercial and risk matters clearly and concisely, verbally and in writing.

○ High levels of initiative, judgement, accountability and commitment to continuous improvement.

○ Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

Hybrid working. 3 days in office, 2 days from home. From office locations in Dorking, London or Basingstoke.

General Summary:
This role will be responsible for leading business development strategy and execution of that strategy across direct (e.g., through brokers, events) and Unum channels. This role is the leader of a market facing team that supports business development by generating early demand for products launched by the Strategic Business Incubator (SBI). This role will be accountable for acquiring early adopters for early minimum viable products (MVP), assisting in development of sales goals for later stage MVP products, and defining and supporting go-forward marketing and sales path for products ready to be transitioned out of the SBI. In parallel, they will be expected to inform SBI’s MVP strategy and choices by representing market feedback.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities
- Lead business development strategy focusing on Unum channel and broker direct, as well as partner with other SBI leaders and stakeholders to inform yearly goals and targets
- Work closely with other SBI leaders to ensure clear and concise value story for SBI portfolio including providing real time feedback from in-market conversations on adjustments needed
- Orchestrate channel market development efforts (communication/engagement campaigns, etc.) that can be delivered through key sales partners, as well as in various industry venues, incl. conferences
- Responsible for defining the end-to-end sales and sales enablement process for SBI products (aligned to level of maturity) with focus on scalability for more mature MVP products
- Lead a team of Business Development Executives and Support professionals to deliver the goals of SBI portfolio, utilizing strategies across early adoption, new business growth, cross-sales as well as upselling. Accountable for ensuring that the team members: - Follow all sales processes, including adoption and consistent utilization of Salesforce
- Execute sales process, including lead qualification, demos and closing deals
- Use technical knowledge of the product and integrations to provide critical customer feedback to the Product Team to support Sales
- Drive a consistent and efficient customer acquisition process from sales through hand off to Customer Success

Resolution of complex inquiries will require advanced critical thinking skills and knowledge across all products, services, and platforms. This role will provide highly responsive service to brokers and field/home office partners to achieve common goals/objectives including enriching broker relationships and servicing new and existing business. Services provided will cover any broker inquiry type for every line of Unum business (contracting through payment of commissions). Communication will be facilitated through different mediums (telephone, email, written correspondence). - Serve as a designated resource to provide the highest quality of service for select brokers as well as key internal partners
- Anticipate and deliver on the broker/customer’s needs.
- Utilize critical thinking to analyze the root cause of an issue and attain full resolution.
- Help identify and drive change initiatives to improve workflows and enhance customer service.
- Provide support to the leadership team on high profile customers and escalated issues
- Collaborate towards meeting team goals that impact the success of departmental objectives

- Operate and deliver high quality results in a fast paced and multifaceted service environment with a sense of urgency
- Strong interpersonal, conflict resolution, and reasoning skills.
- Strong written/verbal communication skills
- Interacts effectively at all levels of the organization, adjusting communications for the intended audience.

- Identify and actively contribute to the implementation of continuous improvement opportunities, resulting in improved processes, efficiencies, and overall service

General Summary:
This position is accountable for providing financial management, business strategies for the compensation design and analysis that drives the sales activities for Colonial Life’s agents and W2 support positions. This includes design, development, implementation and analysis of compensation and incentive programs for all levels of the independent contractor field sales force and employees who provide sales management and sales support. In addition, provide distribution strategy analysis and recommendations. Leadership expectations include maximizing opportunities to better educate Home Office employees and independent contractors how our compensation plans support sales strategies.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities
The first 3 points make up 60% of the job responsibilities
- Design, develop, implement and manage sales compensation plans that align corporate and field sales force objectives.
- Develop and deliver effective sales compensation tools for the sales organization such as: compensation plans and income projection models and provide training on the use of these tools.
- Initiate and supervise sales planning and related adjustments for the field force
- Develop and manage cost effective financing programs that help attract and retain successful sales managers.
- Ownership of Colonial Life’s sales projection process which drives significant enterprise wide financial decisions.
- Support the AVP Comp Design, Sales Planning & Analysis, and Head of Sales with distribution strategy, performance management, and other related topics.
- Provide analytical support and make recommendations for Colonial’s Incentive & Awards programs.
- Work with all levels of sales management to evaluate profitable sales opportunities and meet with potential large producing reps, managers, and brokers.
- Negotiate and resolve compensation related conflicts.
- Provide liaison support and guidance to other Colonial Life departments such as product marketing and broker marketing that either impact or are impacted by sales force compensation.
- Leads strategic work associated with compensation and data analysis tied to the enterprises initiatives such as Cross Brand Sales (CBS), Gathr, etc.
- Scope of responsibilities impact the following: - 10,000 + independent career agents with 40+ compensation plans
- 200 + employee sales management and sales support positions with 10+ compensation plans
- Annual 1099 compensation of $350M+
- Annual W2 compensation of $25M+

- Performs other duties as assigned

Job Specifications
- Proven analysis, problem solving and decision-making skills.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to negotiate and interact with all levels of the sales force and home office employees including senior management.
- High level of initiative, flexibility and desire.

Preferred
- In-depth knowledge of the Colonial sales organization and sales compensation programs.
- MBA with 5+ years experience involving financial, business and sales analysis, (or BS/BA in related field with 10+ years of relevant experience).
- High level of experience with financial analysis and cost benefit analysis.
- Familiarity with Colonial’s home office sales support functions.
- Familiarity with Colonial’s financial, actuarial, operational, and marketing functions.
- Life and health insurance industry experience.
